title: Taken while you watched
literal_meaning: Mahapatra took it away; the onlooker could only stare, bewildered.
explanation: A shrewd person gains the advantage while someone else watches helplessly. The bite lies in noticing the trick too late.
meaning_odia: ଚତୁର ଲୋକ ନିଜ କାମ ହାସଲ କରିନିଏ, ଆଉ ଜଣେ ଜଳକା ହୋଇ ଚାହିଁ ରହିଯାଏ।
usage_example: A bidder secures the last stall while another is still trying to understand the rules. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Mahapatra is retained from the wording, not treated as evidence about a surname or community.
